fixSteps.title: Reduce load
fixSteps.instruction: Wash smaller loads to reduce strain.

fixSteps.title: Pro inspection
fixSteps.instruction: If recurring, suspect bearings.

whenToCallPro: Bearing replacement is major work.

faq.q: Recurring?
faq.a: Yes — early sign of bearing issues.

title: Heater Element Open
shortDescription: Heating element open circuit.
fullDescription: E63 indicates the wash heater element is open.

fixSteps.title: Test resistance
fixSteps.instruction: Measure across heater terminals.

fixSteps.title: Replace heater
fixSteps.instruction: Swap heater element from rear panel.

whenToCallPro: Ensure tub is empty before removal.

faq.q: Can I wash cold?
faq.a: Yes, cold-only cycles work.

title: Heater Relay Fault
shortDescription: Heater control relay fault on main board.
fullDescription: E66 indicates the heater relay on the main board failed (open or stuck).

fixSteps.title: Pro service
fixSteps.instruction: Board-level diagnosis.

whenToCallPro: Always pro.

faq.q: Why a relay?
faq.a: To safely switch the heater on/off under control.

title: NTC Drying Fault
shortDescription: Dryer NTC sensor fault (washer-dryer combos).
fullDescription: E70 indicates the drying section NTC sensor is faulty.

fixSteps.title: Test
fixSteps.instruction: Measure NTC.

fixSteps.title: Replace
fixSteps.instruction: Swap sensor.

whenToCallPro: Combo units are tightly packaged.

faq.q: Affects washing?
faq.a: No — only drying.

title: Door Software Fault
shortDescription: Door interlock state inconsistent in software.
fullDescription: E80 indicates the control software detected an impossible door state transition.

fixSteps.title: Power cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug 10 minutes.

fixSteps.title: Replace lock
fixSteps.instruction: Swap door lock module.

whenToCallPro: Pro for repeat issues.

faq.q: Stuck closed?
faq.a: Wait 10 minutes after unplugging.

title: Pressure Sensor Disconnected
shortDescription: Analog pressure sensor reports invalid or no signal.
fullDescription: AEG washer error E15 indicates pressure sensor failure. The wash program is halted and the fault is shown on the LED display or program lights. Most E1-series faults require diagnostics with a multimeter.
symptoms: Cycle aborts with water possibly in drum
Door may stay locked until cleared
Repeat fault if root cause not resolved

fixSteps.title: Reset
fixSteps.instruction: Turn the program dial to OFF, unplug for 60 seconds, then plug back in.

fixSteps.title: Inspect
fixSteps.instruction: Tip the machine forward (with water removed) and visually check connectors at the suspected component.

fixSteps.title: Test
fixSteps.instruction: Measure component values with a multimeter per the AEG service guide and replace as needed.

whenToCallPro: PCB and inverter replacements for E15 should be performed by an AEG-authorized technician, as post-replacement calibration may be required.

faq.q: How do I drain my AEG washer manually?
faq.a: Use the small drain hose behind the lower kick panel - place a shallow tray, remove the cap, and let the water drain.

faq.q: Is the door safe to force open?
faq.a: No - forcing the door damages the lock and can cause injury if water remains.

title: Boot Seal Air Leak
shortDescription: Door boot seal is allowing water to escape past the bellows.
fullDescription: E16 fires when the pressure system reads a slow leak during the rinse phase, typically caused by a perforated boot seal.

causes.cause: Foreign object lodged in boot fold

symptoms: Water on floor in front of washer

fixSteps.title: Inspect boot seal
fixSteps.instruction: Pull the boot fold open and search for tears or coins.

fixSteps.title: Replace boot
fixSteps.instruction: Remove the front clamp and swap the boot seal.

whenToCallPro: Boot replacement involves removing the front bezel and is best done by AEG service.

faq.q: Why so common?
faq.a: Underwire bras and coins frequently puncture the boot.

title: Inlet Valve Stuck Open
shortDescription: Inlet valve continues to fill after pressure satisfied.
fullDescription: E17 trips when the pressure sensor reaches setpoint but the inlet valve still flows water for over 30 seconds.

fixSteps.title: Shut off supply
fixSteps.instruction: Close water taps to halt fill while diagnosing.

fixSteps.title: Replace valve
fixSteps.instruction: Disconnect inlet hoses and swap the dual valve assembly.

whenToCallPro: If a new valve still leaks through, the control board may be stuck on. Service required.

faq.q: Could low water pressure cause this?
faq.a: No — low pressure causes E11 (no fill) instead.

title: Tachogenerator Open Circuit
shortDescription: Motor tach feedback open.
fullDescription: E18 logs when the drum motor's tachogenerator returns no pulses, preventing speed control.

fixSteps.title: Reseat tach connector
fixSteps.instruction: Pull rear panel and reseat the tach plug at the motor.

fixSteps.title: Test resistance
fixSteps.instruction: Tach coil should read 50-150 ohms; replace if open.

whenToCallPro: If tach is good, the inverter board needs service.

faq.q: Will the heater still work?
faq.a: Yes, but spin won't engage so cycles abort.

title: Inverter IGBT Over-Temp
shortDescription: Motor inverter shut down due to high IGBT temperature.
fullDescription: E19 is logged by the variable-speed inverter when the IGBT module exceeds 95°C, often after repeated unbalanced loads.

fixSteps.title: Cool down
fixSteps.instruction: Allow the washer to rest for 30 minutes after E19; redistribute load.

fixSteps.title: Verify inverter fan
fixSteps.instruction: Pull rear cover and confirm the small inverter fan spins during spin command.

whenToCallPro: If the IGBT is failed, replace the inverter board with AEG OEM part.

faq.q: Could small loads cause this?
faq.a: Yes — small loads bunch and create vibration that drives spin retries and heat.

title: Drum Bearing Wear Detected
shortDescription: Vibration sensor detected bearing wear pattern.
fullDescription: E26 is a service hint based on accelerometer data trending toward a worn drum bearing.

fixSteps.title: Service hint only
fixSteps.instruction: E26 does not block cycles; schedule bearing service to prevent tub damage.

whenToCallPro: Drum bearing service requires complete tub disassembly — best handled by AEG.

faq.q: How long can I delay?
faq.a: Up to a few weeks; ignoring it can damage the tub spider and double the repair cost.

title: Soft-Plus Module Comm Loss
shortDescription: Soft-Plus auto-dose module not responding.
fullDescription: E27 logs when the Soft-Plus module that handles fabric softener auto-dosing fails to acknowledge dose commands.

fixSteps.title: Refill softener
fixSteps.instruction: Top up the auto-dose reservoir with AEG-approved softener.

whenToCallPro: If the cartridge is full and harness is sound, the module needs replacement.

faq.q: Can I dose softener manually?
faq.a: Yes — use the auxiliary slot in the detergent drawer.

title: Steam Refresh Pump Dry-Run
shortDescription: Steam refresh pump ran without water.
fullDescription: E28 trips when the steam pump runs for 30 seconds without raising boiler temperature, indicating a dry boiler.

fixSteps.title: Verify water supply
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm the cold tap is open and inlet hoses are not kinked.

whenToCallPro: If the pump runs but no water enters, replace the pump.

faq.q: Is the boiler damaged?
faq.a: Auto-shutdown protects the heater; no damage if E28 cleared promptly.

title: ÖKOMix Mixer Not Detected
shortDescription: ÖKOMix pre-mix module is not communicating.
fullDescription: E29 logs when the pre-mix module (used to dissolve detergent before contact with fabric) fails handshake.

fixSteps.title: Reseat harness
fixSteps.instruction: Pull the dispenser drawer and reseat the harness behind it.

whenToCallPro: If reseating fails, the mixer pump must be replaced.

faq.q: Should I disable ÖKOMix?
faq.a: If you wash mostly delicate items, AEG allows toggling it off until repair.

title: Drum Light LED Failure
shortDescription: Drum interior LED open circuit.
fullDescription: E48 is reported when the drum LED current is zero, usually from a failed LED panel.

fixSteps.title: Reseat harness
fixSteps.instruction: Remove the top panel and reseat the LED harness on the rear of the tub front.

whenToCallPro: Comfortable for DIY if you have rear access; otherwise call service.

faq.q: Will laundry still wash?
faq.a: Yes — only the drum light is affected.

title: Wi-Fi Provisioning Timeout
shortDescription: Wi-Fi setup did not complete within 5 minutes.
fullDescription: E58 is a soft alert when the My AEG app provisioning flow times out without Wi-Fi credentials.

fixSteps.title: Restart provisioning
fixSteps.instruction: Hold the Wi-Fi button for 10 seconds and reconnect from the My AEG app.

whenToCallPro: Replace the Wi-Fi module only if multiple provisioning attempts fail across 2.4 GHz networks.

faq.q: Do I need Wi-Fi?
faq.a: No — the washer runs all cycles offline.
